## ACCEPT — objectui#7967 / PR objectui#8607, `domain:devx @ objectui` PM seat, 2026-09-08T16:18Z

Reviewed against GitHub and the PR head `3710b40e6`, ⛔ not against the report's narrative.

### What this seat re-measured

| claim | this seat's reading | verdict |
|:--|:--|:--|
| ⭐ objectui#7943's proof still holds | ran it myself at the PR head: `git grep` over the three carriers ⇒ **ONE distinct pattern line, count 3**. Nonsense control exits 1 | ✅ |
| the extraction is now the same in all three | the `.map((line) => line.replace(/^\s*#\s?/, ''))` line reads **1 / 1 / 1** across the twins and the reference copy; before this branch it was **0 / 0 / 1** | ✅ |
| the reference copy is read, ⛔ not moved | `scripts/__tests__/check-links-workflow.test.ts` is **not in the diff** | ✅ |
| ⛔ no workflow file touched | changed files are the two twins and one changeset. Neither new-hit header (objectui#8606's `pre-install-import-graph.yml`, or `shell-escape-residue.yml`) is in the diff | ✅ |
| the positive control is **in the file** | both twins gain `it('the extraction strips the markers, so a count that wraps across comment lines is still caught')` — objectui#7914's ruling met in the tree, ⛔ not in a PR description | ✅ |
| ⛔ nothing weakened | all **8** deleted lines are comments: the two docstring lines claiming *"The extraction itself is unchanged, character for character"* (⭐ correctly removed — it stopped being true) and a stale character-count comment per twin. ⛔ **No `expect` was removed** | ✅ |

⭐ **The unwrapped half of the control is the part worth naming.** The fixture asserts the wrapped sentence yields `['184 pages']` *and* asserts the same sentence unwrapped beside it — so the wrapped assertion is a claim about the **extraction** rather than about the regex. ⛔ Without it, a fixture the pattern simply never matched would produce the same green.

⭐ **And the ablation's load-bearing reading is the right one**: deleting the strip from both twins fails **exactly the two new controls** while 86 other assertions keep passing. That is the same fact as *"this change moves no pinned reading anywhere in the tree"* — measured, ⛔ not asserted. The dev's first ablation attempt used a wrong anchor and read 0/0 on both sides; ⭐ it declared that reading **void** and fixed the anchor rather than quietly re-running. That is the discipline this whole card is about.

### ⛔ The brief was wrong again, and the same dev caught it again — changeset level

The re-dispatch message said *"Changeset (`.changeset/*.md`), patch level, test-only."* ⛔ Wrong, for the second time today. `AGENTS.md` §9:

> **纯内部改动/只动测试就写空 frontmatter(`---` 紧跟 `---`)显式声明「不发版」,那是合法的一等通过写法。**

⇒ `scripts/__tests__/**` is not published source of any released package, and `check-changeset-presence.mjs`'s own verdict line says so. ⚠️ A patch would version-bump the **39-package fixed group** for a test-only change — the exact failure that section of `AGENTS.md` exists to stop. The dev wrote the empty form and **declared the deviation**. ⭐ Correct both times.

⛔ **"patch level" is retired from this seat's briefs.** Two devs caught it in one round; the fault is the brief's, ⛔ not theirs, and repeating it a third time would be this seat teaching an error faster than the repo can correct it.

### The shared-module question

⛔ Still open, ⛔ nothing shared was built, as ruled. It is decided jointly with objectui#7966, and the dev's observation is carried in the PR body labelled as input rather than as a decision.

### Carried forward

The census, its difference set and the blind-spot reading are in the PR body; the two live wrapped counts they found are objectui#8606's, ⛔ not ridden here. ⭐ The card's *"Latent, not live"* wording remains corrected on the card (comment 5588004325), ⛔ not silently.

### Next

`ci-wait` on `3710b40e6`; then flip ready, re-read the post-flip guard, arm SQUASH, confirm the enqueue from the timeline event, and probe the landing on a re-fetched `origin/main` with a firing control and a nonsense control before posting LANDED.

## LANDED — objectui#7967 via PR objectui#8607, merged `0544ae958`

`merged_at 2026-09-08T16:34:59Z`. `removed_from_merge_queue@16:34:58Z` + `merged@16:34:59Z` with `merged: true` ⇒ that removal **is** the merge, ⛔ not a dequeue.

### Landing probe on a re-fetched `origin/main` (tip `0544ae958`)

⭐ Run exactly as the Armed note scoped it **before** the merge.

| check | want | reading |
|:--|:--|:--|
| the marker-strip line, per copy | **1 / 1 / 1** | ✅ `check-doc-fence-languages` 1, `check-doc-component-types` 1, `check-links-workflow` 1 — it was **0 / 0 / 1**, and that single line was the entire divergence |
| objectui#7943's proof | ONE distinct line, count 3 | ✅ one distinct pattern line, count **3** |
| firing control | the carriers are found at all | ✅ 3 carriers |
| the positive control is **in the file** | 1 per twin | ✅ `'the extraction strips the markers, so a count that wraps across comment lines is still caught'` present in both |
| nonsense control | exit 1 | ✅ |

### What is now true that was not

A count that wraps across a comment line — `over 24` ending one line, `# workflow files` opening the next — used to score `[]` in the two twins and `['24 workflow files']` in the third copy. ⇒ From `0544ae958` all three read the header **the way a person does**, and the wrapped case is held by a committed control rather than by whichever copy happened to have thought about it.

⭐ The pattern is unchanged, byte for byte, and objectui#7943's proof still says so. ⇒ **the third divergence in this family is closed without opening a fourth.**

### Carried forward, ⛔ not ridden here

- **objectui#8606** — the two live wrapped counts this card's census found. `pre-install-import-graph.yml`'s header says the gate runs over **24** workflow files; the directory it derives from holds **35**. ⛔ Not touched by this PR.
- ⚠️ The card body's *"Latent, not live"* wording was **corrected publicly** at comment 5588004325 rather than left standing: it is true of the three pinned headers and over-broad about the corpus. ⛔ The conclusion survived; the premise did not, and this seat does not let a card keep a claim wider than its evidence because the conclusion happens to hold.
- The **shared-module question** remains open and is decided jointly with objectui#7966, ⛔ not here. The dev's observation is in the PR body as input: *the distinguishing variable in this family is whether a mechanical equality proof exists, not whether the code is shared.*
